scenes.say: Five hundred rupees joining bonus on the LenzKare app. Here's what to do, and what not to do.

scenes.en: Download the LenzKare app from Google Play.
scenes.say: Do download the LenzKare app from Google Play.

scenes.en: The ₹500 bonus works on your first app order of ₹1,500 or more.
scenes.ta: முதல் ஆர்டர் 1,500 ரூபாய் அல்லது அதற்கு மேல்
scenes.say: Do place your first app order of fifteen hundred rupees or more. That's when the bonus applies.

scenes.en: Use the bonus within 30 days of downloading.
scenes.say: Don't wait too long. Use your bonus within thirty days of downloading the app.

scenes.en: The bonus works with B1G1 on spectacles with Fusion lenses.
scenes.say: Don't forget, it works with buy one get one free on spectacles with Fusion lenses. One pair for you, one for Appa.

scenes.en: Free delivery in South India. No cash on delivery.
scenes.say: Your glasses come to your door. Delivery is free across South India. Please note, there's no cash on delivery.

scenes.en: Free eye test in our store. Home eye test in Chennai: ₹100 for the whole family.
scenes.ta: வீட்டில் முழு குடும்பத்துக்கும் கண் பரிசோதனை 100 ரூபாய்
scenes.say: Need your power first? The eye test in our store is free. Our home eye test in Chennai is one hundred rupees for the whole family.
